csx._comment: This file is THIS REPOSITORY's own dev config, not an install recipe. It resolves csx from PATH, which works here because the agent inherits this shell. Do not copy it: outside a shell-launched agent — any GUI or editor client — a bare 'csx' fails, and the macOS/Linux installer only prints how to add ~/.local/bin to PATH, it does not add it. Get the entry that works on your machine from `csx mcp-config` (`--toml` for Codex); it prints the absolute binary path. See llms-install.md.
